# Every WOFF 2 in the CSS Working Group's suite, as read by google/woff2 --
# the format's own reference decoder, run on the same bytes.
#
# One line per file: <woff2 sha256, 16 hex> <sfnt length> <sfnt sha256, 16 hex>.
# Keyed by the file's own hash rather than by its path, so that a font the
# suite replaces upstream drops out of the comparison instead of failing it
# -- see TestWOFF2RebuildsAsTheReferenceDoes, which requires a floor on how
# many still match so the coverage cannot quietly fall to nothing.
#
# Regenerate with woff2_decompress over testdata/wpt/**/*.woff2.
